program.name: Calf Tabata Ladder
program.subject: Calves & lower legs
program.blurb: Lower legs two ways: calf Tabatas and raises one day, a raise-and-hop ladder the next.
program.about: Calves for work capacity and for strength. One day is Tabatas of raises, hops and shin work, then heavy raises in straight sets; the other is a ladder of raises and hops, one of each, then two, then three, with shins after. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Calf tabatas & raises / raise & hop ladder
